en: Air is not empty space; the air inside an inflated balloon actually has measurable mass and takes up physical space.
Melting ice into liquid water is a physical change because the chemical structure of the H2O molecules remains completely identical.
Liquid water evaporates into a gas at normal room temperature, not only when it reaches its boiling point.
Dissolving sugar in water creates a solution where sugar molecules remain intact and can be recovered through evaporation.
Iron rusting is a chemical change because the metal reacts with oxygen to form a completely new substance called iron oxide.
Honey flows much slower than water because honey possesses a higher viscosity, which is a liquid's resistance to flowing.
A massive steel ship floats in the ocean because its hollow shape makes its overall density lower than water.
Burning wood is a chemical change that transforms the solid material into new substances like ash, smoke, and invisible gases.
You cannot separate dissolved salt from water using a filter because the individual salt particles are too small.
Molding solid clay into a new shape is a physical change because the fundamental material of the clay remains identical.
Water droplets on the outside of a cold glass form from invisible water vapor in the surrounding air condensing.
Cutting a piece of paper in half is a physical change because the chemical composition of the paper remains unchanged.
